title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Erweiterung Schulzentrum Glinde - Leistungen der technischen Beratung
description: Die Stadt Glinde plant die Erweiterung und Sanierung des Schulzentrums am Standort Oher Weg. Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens sind technische Beratungsleistungen für einen Erweiterungsneubau (1. Bauabschnitt) mit ca. 4.500 m² BGF. Der 1 Bauabschnitt soll zeitlich vor der Sanierung des bestehenden Schulgebäudes (2. Bauabschnitt) errichtet werden und insbesondere Flächen für Schulsozialarbeit, Jahrgangscluster, Flex-Klassen, Musik, Pausenhalle und Verwaltung aufnehmen. Für die Vergabe der Planungs- und Bauleistungen ist eine kumulative Vergabe an einen Totalunternehmer/-übernehmer (TU/TÜ) vorgesehen. Die technische Beratung umfasst insbesondere die Vorbereitung und Begleitung des Vergabeverfahrens, die Erstellung und Fortschreibung der funktionalen Leistungsbeschreibung einschließlich der technischen Vergabeunterlagen sowie das planungs- und baubegleitende Controlling bis zur Übergabe und Inbetriebnahme des 1. Bauabschnitts. Die juristische Beratung und Projektsteuerung sind nicht Bestandteil dieses Auftrags. Im Weiteren siehe Ziffer 5.1. der Bekanntmachung.

title: NLP Condition Survey Programme
description: North Lanarkshire Properties (NLP) has a requirement to update its asset management register in respect of the condition of its property estate to ensure compliance with its statutory and legal obligations and to inform a multiyear investment strategy. The resulting dataset will form the foundation of NLP's future asset management, lifecycle investment, maintenance planning and portfolio optimisation activities. NLP manages a portfolio of approximately 990 assets. The current condition survey programme is anticipated to cover approximately 672 operational property assets, excluding ground lease assets and other property categories outside the scope of this procurement. Information is required on the following split: - 4 Business Centres - 28 Offices - 233 Retail - 402 Industrial - 5 Miscellaneous - 672 Total The procurement is for the appointment of suitably qualified and experienced building surveyor (a âContractorâ) to carry out condition surveys across a number of properties within the NLP portfolio. The aim of the resulting Agreement is to obtain by means of visual inspection consistent, accurate and actionable information regarding the physical condition, statutory compliance, risks, and investment needs of the defined buildings within the estate. Applying the findings to inform a data driven investment strategy to maximise portfolio value. The objectives are to: - Establish the current physical condition of each property asset defined. - Identify defects, risks, and compliance issues. - Provide an assessment of each assetâs life. - Provide prioritised maintenance actions. Year 1-5 with year 1 being the faults in most urgent need of attention. - Provide costs as a basis for estimating and to identify the level of funding required for future capital and revenue expenditure. - Provide sufficient information to allow a maintenance programme to be developed over a planned period that will support operational planning and asset management decision making - Deliver the condition survey in accordance with the following mandatory professional standards: a. RICS Building Surveying Standards & Guidance b. RICS Surveying Safely c. RICS New Rules of Measurement (NRM) for cost estimation d. PFI Asset Condition Playbook (2025) â survey methodology and reporting guidance e. General Implementation Guidance (2025) for asset condition hand back surveys f. Centre of Best Practice (CoBP) specification (where applicable) The purpose of the commission is to provide portfolio-wide condition intelligence to support NLP asset management and investment decisions through Level 1 visual, non-intrusive surveys.

title: NLP Condition Survey Programme
description: North Lanarkshire Properties (NLP) has a requirement to update its asset management register in respect of the condition of its property estate to ensure compliance with its statutory and legal obligations and to inform a multiyear investment strategy. The resulting dataset will form the foundation of NLP's future asset management, lifecycle investment, maintenance planning and portfolio optimisation activities. NLP manages a portfolio of approximately 990 assets. The current condition survey programme is anticipated to cover approximately 672 operational property assets, excluding ground lease assets and other property categories outside the scope of this procurement. Information is required on the following split: - 4 Business Centres - 28 Offices - 233 Retail - 402 Industrial - 5 Miscellaneous - 672 Total The procurement is for the appointment of suitably qualified and experienced building surveyor (a âContractorâ) to carry out condition surveys across a number of properties within the NLP portfolio. The aim of the resulting Agreement is to obtain by means of visual inspection consistent, accurate and actionable information regarding the physical condition, statutory compliance, risks, and investment needs of the defined buildings within the estate. Applying the findings to inform a data driven investment strategy to maximise portfolio value. The objectives are to: - Establish the current physical condition of each property asset defined. - Identify defects, risks, and compliance issues. - Provide an assessment of each assetâs life. - Provide prioritised maintenance actions. Year 1-5 with year 1 being the faults in most urgent need of attention. - Provide costs as a basis for estimating and to identify the level of funding required for future capital and revenue expenditure. - Provide sufficient information to allow a maintenance programme to be developed over a planned period that will support operational planning and asset management decision making - Deliver the condition survey in accordance with the following mandatory professional standards: a. RICS Building Surveying Standards & Guidance b. RICS Surveying Safely c. RICS New Rules of Measurement (NRM) for cost estimation d. PFI Asset Condition Playbook (2025) â survey methodology and reporting guidance e. General Implementation Guidance (2025) for asset condition hand back surveys f. Centre of Best Practice (CoBP) specification (where applicable) The purpose of the commission is to provide portfolio-wide condition intelligence to support NLP asset management and investment decisions through Level 1 visual, non-intrusive surveys.

description: Maatschappelijke diensttijd (MDT) is een programma van het ministerie van OCW, in samenwerking met jongeren, maatschappelijke organisaties, scholen, gemeenten en andere ministeries. Tijdens dit programma kiezen jongeren – tussen de 12 en 30 jaar oud - ervoor hun talenten te ontwikkelen, nieuwe mensen te ontmoeten en tegelijkertijd iets te doen voor een ander en/of de samenleving. De verzamelde gegevens worden gebruikt om inzicht te krijgen in de effecten en de impact van MDT. title: Kotimaisten sanoma- ja aikakauslehtien digitaalisen palvelun hankinta
description: Kotimaisten sanoma- ja aikakauslehtien digitaalisen palvelun hankinta KUVAUS HANKINNASTA Hankinnan kohteena on kotimaisten sanoma- ja aikakauslehtien digitaalinen palvelu, johon kuuluu lehtivalikoima ja käyttöliittymä lehtien käyttöön, selailuun, hakuun ja lukemiseen sekä niihin liittyvät tukipalvelut. Tilaajan on mahdollista saada palvelun ja sen sisältämien lehtien käytöstä erilaisia käyttötilastoja. Pääsy kotimaisten sanoma- ja aikakauslehtien digitaaliseen palveluun tulee olla koko valtioneuvostolle (ministeriöt, oikeuskanslerinvirasto ja tasavallan presidentin kanslia). Pääsy palveluun mahdollistetaan IP-tunnistautumisella tai SSO-kertakirjautumisella, jotka varmistavat sen, että vain Tilaajan auktorisoidut käyttäjät pääsevät käyttämään palvelua. Tilaajan henkilöstöllä on pääsy Toimittajan SaaS-palveluna ylläpitämään palvelualustaan, joka sisältää Tilaajan valitsemat ja hankkimat kotimaiset sanoma- ja aikakauslehdet. Tilaajan henkilöstö voi selata kokoelmaa, kohdistaa hakuja kokoelman nimekkeisiin ja valita lehtinimekkeen luettavaksi. Palvelualustan ominaisuudet ja toiminnallisuudet on esitelty liitteessä 1 ”Vähimmäisvaatimukset”. Palvelun linkki tai linkit yksittäisiin palvelussa oleviin lehtinimikkeisiin julkaistaan Tilaajan intranetissä sekä muilla sisäisillä sivustoilla, joissa valtioneuvoston käyttöön hankittuja tietoaineistoja esitellään valtioneuvoston henkilöstölle. Palveluun ja siihen Tilaajan tilaamiin lehtiin tulee olla etäkäyttöoikeus. Etäkäytöllä tarkoitetaan sitä, että etätyössä Tilaajan henkilöstö käyttää palvelua työnantajan tarjoamilla laitteilla valtioneuvoston verkossa. Hankintaan sisältyy lisähankintamahdollisuus sopimuskauden aikana yksittäisiin uusiin sanoma- ja aikakauslehtinimikkeisiin. Yhtä aikakauslehteä voi lukea samanaikaisesti etukäteen lehtikohtaisesti määritetty määrä käyttäjiä. Sanomalehtivalikoimaa voi lukea samanaikaisesti kuusi käyttäjää. Palvelu on Tilaajan henkilöstön käytettävissä ympärivuorokautisesti vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjoukseensa kotimaisten sanoma- ja aikakauslehtien digitaalista palvelua koskeva kuvaus. Tarjouskilpailun perusteella Tilaaja valitsee yhden toimittajan, jonka kanssa se tekee sopimuksen. KÄYTTÖÖNOTTOPROJEKTI Palvelun käyttöönotto tulee alkaa sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta ja käyttöönoton tulee olla valmis 1 kuukauden kuluttua sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta. Käyttöönottoprojektin sisältö on palvelun perustaminen sekä käyttöönotto. Käyttöönoton aikana todetaan palvelun vaatimustenmukaisuus. Käyttöönottoprojektin aikana toimittajan tehtävänä on: - Kaikkien niiden ominaisuuksien toteuttaminen, joihin toimittaja on tarjouksellaan sitoutunut. - Avata Tilaajalle pääsyn tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 2 Hintalomake määritettyyn sanoma- ja aikakauslehtivalikoimaan. - Avustaa Tilaajaa tarvittaessa hyväksymistestauksen aikana. Käyttöönotto päättyy, kun kaikki tehtävät on toteutettu ja Tilaaja on testannut toimitetun järjestelmän ja todennut järjestelmän ominaisuuksien osalta hyväksytyksi. Jos testauksessa havaitaan puutteita, Toimittaja korjaa puutteet ja Tilaaja testaa nämä uudelleen. Testaus jatkuu niin kauan, kunnes Tilaaja toteaa vaiheen hyväksyttäväksi, ellei Tilaaja katso järjestelmää niin puutteelliseksi, ettei käyttöönottoa voida jatkaa.,

description: 1/ La présente consultation vise la passation d'une procédure ayant pour objet des prestations de réparation de tiroirs de pilotage automatique pour le métro de la Régie des Transports Métropolitains. Cette pièce générale réputée connue par les entreprises est non fournie dans le présent dossier. 6/ La durée du contrat est de trois (3) ans ferme, à compter de sa date de notification. 7/ Au stade des candidatures, les documents transmis avec l'Avis d'Appel Public à la Concurrence (AAPC) figurent dans le Règlement de la consultation "Phase candidature" joint en annexe de l'AAPC. 8/ Les candidats doivent obligatoirement transmettre leur candidature (et leur offre en phase ultérieure) de façon dématérialisée via le site www.achatpublic.com. En phase ultérieure, la RTM mettra à disposition le Dossier de Consultation des Entreprises (DCE) complet aux candidats admis à déposer une offre, via le site www.achatpublic.com qui fournira à ces derniers les modalités de téléchargement. Les candidats devront transmettre leur offre obligatoirement de façon dématérialisée via le site Internet achatpublic.com.

title: Belgium – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Customs SEED+ Maintenance, Upgrade and Risk Management Support
description: Maintenance, support and upgrade of Customs SEED+ and related customs digital systems. Customs SEED+ is a digital platform supporting the systematic electronic exchange of customs data and pre-arrival information between CEFTA customs administrations, and between CEFTA and participating EU Member States through the Green Lanes initiative. The platform supports data exchange, risk management, trade facilitation, monitoring of crossing point performance, and the implementation of common customs cooperation tools. The contract will also support interoperability with local customs systems and related CEFTA systems, gradual alignment with the new Union Customs Code framework and related EU customs data exchange requirements, as well as further development of customs risk management functionalities and support for the recognition of customs controls, including common risk profiles, rapid customs alerts, inspection report data exchange, AEO-related functionalities, statistics and reporting, where relevant.

description: Le présent avis de marché a pour objet de définir les conditions de la consultation relative aux prestations d’infogérance, de support aux utilisateurs et d’exploitation des infrastructures systèmes et applicatives du CEA Grenoble. Les prestations comprennent principalement : - des prestations de gestion d'un centre de services, - des prestations relatives aux postes de travail et services aux utilisateurs, - des prestations relatives à l’installation et l’exploitation des infrastructures systèmes et systèmes industriels, - des prestations relatives à l’installation et l’exploitation de l’hébergement de services métiers et applicatifs, Les prestations seront réalisées, dans les conditions prévues au cahier des charges, dans les locaux du CEA Grenoble ou de ses sites rattachés (INES Bourget du Lac, Metz, Nantes, Bordeaux, Toulouse, Lille, Quimper). Cette consultation est découpée en trois lots : - Lot 1 : Centre de services et postes de travail/environnement utilisateur, - Lot 2 : Infrastructures système et systèmes industriels, - Lot 3 : Infrastructures applicatives et progiciels. La date prévisionnelle du début des marchés est le 1 janvier 2028. La durée des marchés est de 4 ans fermes avec deux périodes de reconduction supplémentaires de douze mois. Les futurs marchés seront composés de différentes phases dont une phase de prise en charge qui se fera en parallèle de la réversibilité du titulaire sortant. Les prestations sont réalisées en présentiel sur le site du CEA Grenoble (Lot 1 ,2 et 3), ainsi que dans des locaux CEA sur ses sites rattachés (Lot 1). Néanmoins, le CEA autorise qu’une part encadrée et limitée de la prestation soit réalisée à distance depuis l’extérieur du site, qu’il s’agisse des locaux du Titulaire, ou du domicile de ses collaborateurs. Cela inclut les interventions d’experts non dédiés à la prestation qui peuvent être localisés à distance.

title: EDC Branded Merchandise Platform
description: EDC is seeking a solution to provide and operate a secure, customizable online Branded Merchandise platform. The platform must allow authorized EDC employees to order approved Branded Merchandise through a centralized online storefront. EDC’s primary objective for this requirement is to support Business Orders for approved Branded Merchandise. EDC is seeking a single vendor of record for the Branded Merchandise program, responsible for end-to-end service delivery on EDC’s behalf, including sourcing, storage, inventory management, fulfillment, and delivery. Where feasible, priority should be given to Canadian-made and Canadian-supplied products. The Preferred Proponent will manage the full lifecycle of Branded Merchandise, including product sourcing, brand compliance, warehousing, pick-and-pack services, fulfillment, and domestic and international shipping. The Proponent must also provide governance and administrative capabilities, such as approvals, budget controls, and reporting. This engagement will help EDC centralize Branded Merchandise management, improve operational efficiency, maintain brand consistency, increase access to approved items, and monitor and control costs across the organization more effectively. EDC aims to achieve the following business objectives: Centralize the management of Branded Merchandise across EDC Improve operational efficiency and cost control Ensure consistent governance and brand application across Branded Merchandise Enable self-service ordering with appropriate governance Provide greater access to all EDC and employees to purchased Branded Merchandise for Business Orders and Personal Purchases Support domestic and international delivery needs Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: Finland – Repair and maintenance services – Kattohuoltopalvelut Kiinteistö Oy Auroranlinnan kiinteistöissä
description: Hankinnan kohteena ovat Kiinteistö oy Auroranlinnalle suoritettavat kattotarkastukset, pienkorjaukset ja akuutit tilaustyöt kiinteistöhuollon tai Auroranlinnan kautta. Auroranlinnalla on kiinteistöjä noin 80 kohteessa ympäri Helsinkiä. Kiinteistöt/yhtiöt ovat kooltaan paritaloista yli 160 asuntoa käsittäviin talokokonaisuuksiin. Tarjoajalla tulee siten olla riittävät resurssit töiden loppuun saattamiseksi. Tehtävään on tarkoitus valita urakoitsija, joka ovat saanut eniten pisteitä kilpailutuksesta. Kohteisiin voi tutustua Auroranlinnan nettisivujen kautta ja paikan päällä käymällä. Sopimus on tarkoitus alkaa 5.1.2027. Sopimus tehdään määräaikaisena 2 vuodeksi. Sopimukseen sisältyy optio (2) kahdesta yhden (1) vuoden pituisesta optiovuodesta.

title: France – Insulators and insulating fittings – Homologation, fourniture et livraison de supports isolateurs pour réseau Métro de la RATP
description: La présente consultation s’inscrit dans le cadre des opérations maintenance des voies du réseau Métro, du projet de modernisation des rames de métro et dans le projet de réfection du viaduc de la ligne 6. Les prestations à réaliser dans le cadre du marché sont les suivantes : • Les études ; • La fabrication des moules ; • L’homologation des isolateurs ; • La fabrication des isolateurs ; • Les contrôles et essais prévus dans les Spécifications Techniques RATP, avec la production des documents de contrôle de conformité ; • Le conditionnement des fournitures ; • Le chargement et le transport des isolateurs ; • La fourniture de la documentation nécessaire à la réception définitive des fournitures sur site RATP ; • La garantie des fournitures. La forme des marchés à l'issue de la consulation sera la suivante : marché à tranches. • Tranche ferme : Fourniture des outillages et homologation des isolateurs ; • Tranche optionnelle : Fourniture et livraison des supports isolateurs. Cette consultation donnera lieu à un accord cadre mono-attributaire alloti composé de 3 lots : • Lot 1 : Homologation, fourniture et livraison de supports isolateurs pour le réseau Métro, sur voies fer ; • Lot 2 : Homologation, fourniture et livraison de supports isolateurs pour le réseau Métro, sur voies pneumatique, équipées de barres de guiage en cornière ; • Lot 3 : Homologation, fourniture et livraison de supports isolateurs pour le réseau Métro, sur voies pneumatique, équipées de barres de guiage en HEB 160 ; La présente consultation est lancée en procédure négociée. La RATP se réserve la possibilité de faire réaliser des prestations similaires par le Titulaire du marché dans les conditions énoncées à l’article R2122-7 du Code de la Commande publique.

Factors I, II, and III, when combined, are approximately equal in importance to Factor IV (Price). FACTOR 1 APPROACH QUALITY MANAGEMENT TECHNICAL FACTOR SUBFACTORS: Subfactor 1a Management Approach Narrative/Schedule Subfactor 1b Quality Management The following subfactors are in descending order of importance: Subfactor 1a Management Approach Narrative/Schedule: Instructions: Offeror shall demonstrate/explain how this project will be accomplished, based on the offeror s best interpretation of the solicitation documents. Project(s) shall have a minimum construction value of between $25,000 and $100,000 and be 100% completed/or ongoing (>50% complete). Focus will be on recent and relevant construction contracts that are comparable in size, scope, and complexity. The following Performance Relevancy definitions apply: Rating Definition Very Relevant Present/Past Performance effort involved essentially the same scope and magnitude of effort and complexities this solicitation requires. Relevant Present/Past Performance effort involved similar scope and magnitude of effort and complexities this solicitation requires. Somewhat Relevant Present/Past Performance effort involved some of the scope and magnitude of effort and complexities this solicitation requires. Not Relevant Present/Past Performance effort involved little or none of the scope and magnitude of effort and complexities this solicitation requires. title: Prototype development for Battlefield Wound Infection Prevention and Treatment (BWI P&T) Barrier Combination
description: This RPP is being issued by the Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA), in support of the Defense Health Agency�s Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Medical Products (MP) Warfighter Protection (WPAC) & Acute Care Program Management Office (PMO) Care located in Frederick, Maryland at Fort Detrick. The Warfighter Protection and Acute Care Project Management Office (WPAC PMO) has a requirement for the development of a Barrier Combination product. The Barrier Combination product is defined as being composed of both a physical barrier to protect a wound and an antibacterial and/or antifungal activity released from the barrier to prevent the spread of organisms and avoid systemic infections. This RPP will result in one award to develop the Battlefield Wound Infection Prevention and Treatment (BWI P&T) Barrier Combination (BC) prototype product. The final product MUST be a combination wound treatment that includes a barrier component that is either infused or impregnated with antimicrobial and/or antifungal properties and have U.S. Food Drug Administration (FDA) approval (or clearance). The award, as a result of this RPP, will be awarded under the authority of prototype Other Transaction Authority (pOTA) 10 U.S.C. 4022.

title: Construction of Chilled Water Plant and Site Utility Upgrades at VA Medical Center in West Haven, CT
description: The scope of the chilled water plant replacement consists of the demolition of the existing chilled water plant (building 16a) and construction of a new multi-story chilled water plant to include chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and all associated mechanical and electrical equipment. Due to the close proximity of the existing fuel tank farm adjacent to the existing chilled water plant, a new fuel tank farm will need to be constructed as part of the project, which primarily serves the central boiler plant, requiring close coordination with the medical center and ongoing related projects.The scope of the site utility upgrades consists of the replacement and upgrade of the existing fire protection water main and the domestic water main from Campbell Avenue to Building 15. Site utility upgrades also include providing utility main loops of chilled water supply and return, steam supply, condensate return, domestic water supply, and fire protection water supply which will originate from the new chilled water plant and back-feed to Building 1. The work also includes the installation of redundant electrical feeder from the utility demarcation point to Building 19 and coordination with the local electrical utility provider to provide further electrical redundancy offsite as well. In addition, new water storage tanks will be constructed. This project involves civil/site, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, geotechnical, and architectural disciplines. The project must also comply with the DVAs Physical Security Resiliency Design Requirements (PSRDM). It is expected that the chilled water plant will be constructed to meet USGBC LEED Silver certification. The work is located adjacent to and within an active Medical Center campus which will be operational at all times. Impact to on-going operations must be kept to a minimum and carefully coordinated with the Contracting Officer and VAMC staff. In addition, the work area is constrained due to the active medical center operations which will limit laydown and storage areas during construction.

title: Construction of Chilled Water Plant and Site Utility Upgrades at VA Medical Center in West Haven, CT
description: The scope of the chilled water plant replacement consists of the demolition of the existing chilled water plant (building 16a) and construction of a new multi-story chilled water plant to include chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and all associated mechanical and electrical equipment. Due to the close proximity of the existing fuel tank farm adjacent to the existing chilled water plant, a new fuel tank farm will need to be constructed as part of the project, which primarily serves the central boiler plant, requiring close coordination with the medical center and ongoing related projects.The scope of the site utility upgrades consists of the replacement and upgrade of the existing fire protection water main and the domestic water main from Campbell Avenue to Building 15. Site utility upgrades also include providing utility main loops of chilled water supply and return, steam supply, condensate return, domestic water supply, and fire protection water supply which will originate from the new chilled water plant and back-feed to Building 1. The work also includes the installation of redundant electrical feeder from the utility demarcation point to Building 19 and coordination with the local electrical utility provider to provide further electrical redundancy offsite as well. In addition, new water storage tanks will be constructed. This project involves civil/site, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, geotechnical, and architectural disciplines. The project must also comply with the DVAs Physical Security Resiliency Design Requirements (PSRDM). It is expected that the chilled water plant will be constructed to meet USGBC LEED Silver certification. The work is located adjacent to and within an active Medical Center campus which will be operational at all times. Impact to on-going operations must be kept to a minimum and carefully coordinated with the Contracting Officer and VAMC staff. In addition, the work area is constrained due to the active medical center operations which will limit laydown and storage areas during construction.

title: Palm Beach Harbor, South Jetty Rehabilitation 2026, Palm Beach County, Florida
description: The work consists of rehabilitation of the South Jetty at Palm Beach Harbor. Rehabilitation will require substantial moving and manipulation of both new and existing stones to obtain the required interlocking within the tolerances provided. Mobilization of equipment and the construction necessary to repair the jetty must be water-based and require the use of marine construction methods and equipment. Work on top of the jetty will be permitted. Land-based access to the project site will not be permitted. Rehabilitation also consists of concrete repairs to the South Jetty at Palm Beach Harbor as indicated on the drawings. Prior to work on the jetty, conduct a pre-construction benthic community survey on the jetty structure and any adjacent submerged areas that may be impacted by the Contractors operations. Complete any coral relocations required as a result of the benthic survey prior to jetty work. Field personnel conducting coral survey and transplantation activities must either be qualified relocation contractors by the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission or must provide documentation of having successfully conducted relocation of corals in Florida. The project will have an estimated period of performance of 330 calendar days after receipt of the Notice to Proceed (NTP). All non-price evaluation factors must be rated as "ACCEPTABLE" in order to be eligible for award. An "UNACCEPTABLE" rating in any factor will result in the proposal being rated "UNACCEPTABLE" unless corrected through discussions. A proposal rating of "UNACCEPTABLE" makes a proposal ineligible for award. Since the LPTA methodology prohibits trade-offs, all evaluation factors and sub-factors are equally important. Proposals are evaluated for acceptability but not ranked using the non-price factors. A price evaluation will be performed for all offerors and proposals will be ranked from lowest to highest price based on the Total Proposed Price (TPP) provided by the offeror on the price schedule sheet. Next, an evaluation of each factor and, subsequently, the overall proposal will be performed beginning with the lowest priced proposal. Award will be made to the lowest evaluated priced proposal meeting the acceptability standards for the non-price factors. title: INDUSTRY DAYS - WEST HAVEN, CT & TOGUS, ME
description: ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORD MODERNIZATION CONSTRUCTION OPPORTUNITIES The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) is hosting an industry day and is seeking information and potential sources to determine a set-aside, if any, is appropriate for two projects located in the New England area valued between $40M and $100M. The projects are for the procurement of Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) Infrastructure Upgrades construction projects in located at the West Haven VA Medical Center (VAMC) in West Haven, CT, and Togus VAMC, in Togus, ME. Both projects are for design-bid-build phased construction and involve complex electrical and HVAC renovations. VHA PCAC will conduct an industry day to collaborate with general construction contractors and subcontractors of ALL size status� that are interested in doing business with the VA in Connecticut and Maine. The day will start with a meet and greet between VA and Contractor attendees. We will review the design drawings and specifications, conduct a high-level site walkthrough, and discuss the phasing of the project. This will ensure all interested contractors understand the intent and requirements for the project. This industry day will help the VA determine the method of procurement, such as tradeoff, and type of socioeconomic set-aside, if any, highlight any industry concerns, gauge general contractor interest in the project, and perform a site walk to show key areas of the project. This is an opportunity for industry to influence procurement decisions that will shape the course of the project. Your feedback and collaboration is vital for successful construction and deployment of the EHR program. PROJECT DESCRIPTION / DESCRIPTION OF WORK / REQUIREMENT The VA is seeking general contractors to furnish all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision, and perform all work necessary to prepare the site for building operations and complete the EHRM Infrastructure Upgrades construction projects at VA Medical Centers in West Haven, CT, and Togus, ME. Work includes general construction, alterations, telecommunications, electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, Hazardous Waste Removal, and other disciplines as required to complete the scope of these projects. Projects involve expansion of existing telecommunication rooms (TRs), power upgrades, replacement of data cabling with CAT6A, renovation of existing data center to include power / data / equipment / HVAC. All work is to be performed in accordance with the drawings and specifications. ADMINISTRATIVE The industry day will be held on October 27 in in Togus, ME and October 28 West Haven, CT from 9:00 AM ET to 12:00 PM ET at each location. The meeting location for Togus will be the auditorium in Building 210 at the Togus campus located at 810 Eastern Avenue, Augusta ME 04330. The meeting location for West Haven will be the Donaldson Center in Building 2 at the West Haven campus located at 950 Campbell Avenue, West Haven, CT 06516. Take the elevator to the second floor and follow signs to Donaldson Center �C�. Contractors are required to RSVP via email to Jacquelyn.Wise@va.gov AND William.Henkel@va.gov no later than 4:00 PM ET on October 23, 2026. Industry day agenda is provided below for October 27, 2026 at the Togus campus: 09:00 AM � 10:00 AM � Introduction and Discussion/Review of Specs and Drawings 10:00 AM � 11:00 AM � Site Walk Through 11:00 AM � 12:00 PM � Q&A and Industry Feedback. (This can be extended as needed.) Industry day agenda is provided below for October 28, 2026 at the West Haven campus: 09:00 AM � 10:00 AM � Introduction and Discussion/Review of Specs and Drawings 10:00 AM � 11:00 AM � Site Walk Through 11:00 AM � 12:00 PM � Q&A and Industry Feedback. (This can be extended as needed.) This notice is not a request for competitive offers. Any response to this notice will not be considered a bid or proposal. After completing its analyses, the Government will determine whether to limit competition among small business categories or proceed with full and open competition. This notice and event shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Government. The Government will not provide reimbursement for any expenses incurred in participating in this notice and event. Currently, no solicitation exists; therefore, DO NOT REQUEST A COPY OF THE SOLICITATION. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized in Contract Opportunities at https://sam.gov/. It is the potential offeror's responsibility to monitor this site for the release of any solicitation or synopsis. All questions should be submitted via email to Jacquelyn.Wise@va.gov AND William.Henkel@va.gov. title: MODIFIED WC-130J RTP APN-241 WEATHER RADAR SUSTAINING ENGINEERING SUPPORT RESEARCH AND SUPPORT TASK
description: The Government is conducting market research to identify potential sources that possess the expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet qualifications to support repairability maintainability, and sustaining engineering for the modified WC-130J RTP APN-241 Weather Radar. Potential sources must possess the ability to provide engineering studies for the WC-130J RTP APN-241 system in resolving reliability and maintainability issues, obsolete parts issues, identify and propose solutions to Diminishing Manufacturing Sources (DMS) issues, and analyze failure trends from both the depots and the field level shops to support the MC-130J CR-2M developmental testing. For vendors wishing to participate in this Request for Information (RFI), after reviewing the requirement, provide documentation supporting proof of company�s capability to meet the requested requirements. If lacking sufficient experience/capabilities in a particular area, please provide details explaining strategies to overcome the lack of experience/capabilities to perform that portion of the requirement. In accordance with RFO 15.101(c), this RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes - it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request for information does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or services. Responders are advised that the U.S. Government will not reimburse participants for any expenses incurred in response to this RFI; all cost associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested party�s expense. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in future RFPs nor does it ensure participation, if an RFP is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the Federal Business Opportunities (SAM.gov) website. It is the responsibility of the potential offerors to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this requirement. Potential sources must be able to install the APN-241 Weather radar in addition to troubleshooting system discrepancies. Potential sources must be capable of and have access to Northrop Grumman equipment. Potential sources would need to have the ability to ensure equipment would be able to detect rain rates in real-time directly in front of the aircraft either proving or disproving the capability. The proposed services are required to have access to Northrop Grumman Corporation, and their databases which contain/maintain the APN-241 Radar System engineering software. The following equipment is required to sustain WC-130J RTP and will be provided as GFE: RTP P/N 780R270G10 (NSN 5841-01-522-1618), Transmitter Module (1A05) P/N 444R372G01 (NSN 5841-01-433-9455), and General-Purpose Processor Module P/N 824R061G06 (NSN 5998-01-534-5169). The modified configuration provided is the following equipment: WC-130J RTP P/N 780R270G13 (NSN 5841-01-546-5654), Transmitter Module (1A05) P/N 444R372G02 (NSN 6130-01-433-9452). And General- Purpose Processor Module P/N 824R061G13 (NSN 5998-01-564-1569). Provide sustaining engineering support and repairment of the modified configuration: WC-130J RTP P/N 780R270G13 (NSN 5841-01-546-5654), Transmitter Module (1A05) P/N 444R372G02 (NSN 6130-01-433-9452), and General-Purpose Processor Module P/N 824R061G13 (NSN 5998-01-564-1569) Provide engineering support during developmental testing not to exceed 400-man hours and provide on-site support at Eglin AFB for two engineers for a total of three 5-day trips. The proposed acquisition strategy is a 2-year (plus 6-month extension option) contract beginning in FY27 and continuing through FY29. The Government has determined this system is not a commercial item. There are no samples available for potential suppliers to evaluate. title: INDUSTRY DAYS - WEST HAVEN, CT & TOGUS, ME
description: ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORD MODERNIZATION CONSTRUCTION OPPORTUNITIES The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) is hosting an industry day and is seeking information and potential sources to determine a set-aside, if any, is appropriate for two projects located in the New England area valued between $40M and $100M. The projects are for the procurement of Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) Infrastructure Upgrades construction projects in located at the West Haven VA Medical Center (VAMC) in West Haven, CT, and Togus VAMC, in Togus, ME. Both projects are for design-bid-build phased construction and involve complex electrical and HVAC renovations. VHA PCAC will conduct an industry day to collaborate with general construction contractors and subcontractors of ALL size status� that are interested in doing business with the VA in Connecticut and Maine. The day will start with a meet and greet between VA and Contractor attendees. We will review the design drawings and specifications, conduct a high-level site walkthrough, and discuss the phasing of the project. This will ensure all interested contractors understand the intent and requirements for the project. This industry day will help the VA determine the method of procurement, such as tradeoff, and type of socioeconomic set-aside, if any, highlight any industry concerns, gauge general contractor interest in the project, and perform a site walk to show key areas of the project. This is an opportunity for industry to influence procurement decisions that will shape the course of the project. Your feedback and collaboration is vital for successful construction and deployment of the EHR program. PROJECT DESCRIPTION / DESCRIPTION OF WORK / REQUIREMENT The VA is seeking general contractors to furnish all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision, and perform all work necessary to prepare the site for building operations and complete the EHRM Infrastructure Upgrades construction projects at VA Medical Centers in West Haven, CT, and Togus, ME. Work includes general construction, alterations, telecommunications, electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, Hazardous Waste Removal, and other disciplines as required to complete the scope of these projects. Projects involve expansion of existing telecommunication rooms (TRs), power upgrades, replacement of data cabling with CAT6A, renovation of existing data center to include power / data / equipment / HVAC. All work is to be performed in accordance with the drawings and specifications. ADMINISTRATIVE The industry day will be held on October 27, 2026 in Togus, ME and October 28, 2026 in West Haven, CT from 9:00 AM ET to 12:00 PM ET at each location. The meeting location for Togus will be the auditorium in Building 210 at the Togus campus located at 810 Eastern Avenue, Augusta ME 04330. The USCG Aviation Logistics Center is conducting market research to determine repair sources described as follows: BACKGROUND: The U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) operates 18 HC-144 Maritime Patrol Aircraft. These Maritime Patrol Aircraft (MPA) are operated differently from general aviation in support of USCG search and rescue missions, as well as surveillance and reconnaissance missions. The USCG HC-144 missions require frequent operation at lower altitudes and in salt-laden environments. These environments accelerate corrosion on airframe structures, engines and components of the aircraft. The aircraft and its components are inspected by USCG personnel In Accordance With (IAW) the Original Equipment Manufacturer�s (OEM) periodic requirements and in conjunction with the USCG's specialized Asset Computerized Maintenance System (ACMS). This notice is to assist the USCG in determining the potential sources capable of procurement for the items listed below. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) is Saint-Gobain Sully. title: Q522--On-site Board-Certified/Board-Eligible Diagnostic Radiology Physician Services | Orlando VA Healthcare System (OVAHCS)
description: Presolicitation Notice Presolicitation Notice Page 4 of 4 Presolicitation Notice *=Required Field Presolicitation Notice Page 1 of 4 The Department of Veterans Affairs, VISN 08, Orlando VA Healthcare System (OVAHCS), 13800 Veteran s Way, Orlando, FL 32827, intends to solicit an unrestricted full and open competitive Request for Proposals (RFP), to provide services necessary to perform two (2) Full Time Employee Equivalent (FTEE) on-site Board-Certified/Board-Eligible Diagnostic Radiology Physician Services (body imaging, Muscoskeletal (MSK) or Neuroradiology qualified) to eligible beneficiaries of the OVAHCS. The VA Radiology Services follow the standards & guidelines set forth by American College of Radiology (ACR). A contractor providing Diagnostic Radiology Physician Services shall provide services that meet or exceed the American College of Radiology Guidelines https://www.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Practice-Parameters/IRClin-Prac-Mgmt.pdf.pdf. Two (2) Diagnostic Radiologists of differing subspecialties (one (1) Neuro and one (1) MSK; (1) Neuro and one (1) body; or one (1) MSK and one (1) body) are required to be onsite Monday Friday from 8:00am 4:30pm (30-minute lunch) excluding Federal Holidays (full-time basis). No off-hours coverage, on-call duties, or overtime are required. Each Diagnostic Radiologists must produce 9000 work Relative Value Units (wRVUs)/year (4.3 wRVUs/hour; 34.6 wRVUs/day). Qualified substitute personnel with credentials including board-certification/board-eligibility, comparable to designated key personnel must be fully credentialed and privileged and readily available to provide services in the event key personnel are unavailable. Given the importance of continuity of care to the Facility s medical services, the Contractor must maintain a contingency plan to ensure uninterrupted services if a physician departs employment or becomes unable to perform services and provide coverage. Contractor physicians must possess a minimum of three (3) years of continuous Board-Certified/Board-Eligible Diagnostic Radiologist experience within the last four (4) years, including demonstrated proficiency in interpreting Computed Tomography (CT), Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Ultrasound, and Diagnostic X-ray imaging. QUALIFICATIONS: License: The Contractor s physician(s) assigned by the Contractor to perform the services covered by this contract shall have a current license to practice medicine in any State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States or the District of Columbia) when services are performed onsite on VA property. All licenses held by the key personnel working on this contract shall be full and unrestricted licenses. Contractor s physician(s) who have current, full and unrestricted licenses in one or more states, but who have, or ever had, a license restricted, suspended, revoked, voluntarily revoked, voluntarily surrendered pending action or denied upon application will not be considered for the purposes of this contract. Board Certification: All contractor s physician(s) shall be Board-Certified /Board-Eligible per the American Board of Radiology (http://www.theabr.org/). All continuing education courses required for maintaining certification must be kept up to date at all times. Documentation verifying current certification shall be provided by the Contractor to the VA COR on an annual basis for each year of contract performance. Credentialing and Privileging: Credentialing and privileging is to be done in accordance with the provisions of VHA Directive 1100.20 and VHA Directive 1100.21 referenced above. The Contractor is responsible for ensuring that proposed physician(s) possesses the requisite credentials enabling the granting of privileges. No services shall be provided by any Contractor s physician(s) prior to obtaining approval by the Facility Medical Executive Board and Medical Center Director. The period of performance is expected to be from February 1, 2027, through January 31, 2032. The authority of for this procurement is Title 38 USC 8153, Health Care Resources (HCR) Sharing Authority, Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) Part 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services, and RFO 15, Contracting by Negotiation. The solicitation document will be issued as Request for Proposals (RFP) 36C24827R0006 as an unrestricted open and competitive solicitation on or about November 2, 2026. Interested contractors will be responsible for downloading copies of the solicitation and any subsequent amendments from this website. No hard copies will be made available. The solicitation will provide instructions to contractors about the response to the RFP submission process. Prospective contractors are encouraged to register their interest in the solicitation on the SAM.gov | Contract Opportunities website so that they are notified of the issuance of the solicitation and any amendments. In accordance with RFO 52.204-7, System for Award Management (SAM), prospective contractors must be registered in SAM to be eligible for award. Contractors may obtain SAM information at https://sam.gov/. Registration is free and potential offerors are encouraged to visit the SAM website (SAM.gov | Entity Information). The NAICS Code for this procurement is 621111 Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists); Product/Service Code: Q522 Medical-Radiology. The Business Size Standard is $16 million. Any questions concerning this announcement should be directed to Jayne Messer, Contracting Officer, via electronic mail (email) at jayne.messer@va.gov and include the solicitation number on subject line (i.e., RFP 36C24827R0006).
